detail_record: {"ARCH-TIED_UNIFIED_TOOLCHAIN":{"name":"Unified TIED toolchain architecture","status":"Proposed","context":"TIED source repository ships operator tools across Go, TypeScript, Node bootstrap, Ruby legacy, and shell wrappers.","decision":"Adopt TypeScript-on-Node workspace as primary suite language; structure as packages @tied/mcp, @tied/agentstream, @tied/bootstrap, @tied/yaml, @tied/cli with phased port and parity gates.","consequences":{"positive":["Reuse mcp-server investment","Single npm test/build CI matrix","Bootstrap already Node-aligned"],"negative":["Large agentstream port","Temporary dual implementation during strangler phase"]},"alternatives_considered":[{"name":"Go-only suite","description":"Port mcp-server to Go","rejected_because":"Loss of TS analysis/pseudocode stack; larger rewrite than Go→TS port of agentstream only"},{"name":"Rust workspace","description":"cargo install tied-suite","rejected_because":"No existing Rust tooling; highest migration cost"},{"name":"Status quo","description":"Document separate builds only","rejected_because":"Fails sponsor single-language requirement"}]}}
